plan: This is a second-price auction (I pay the second-highest bid if I win). The dominant strategy in a second-price auction is to bid my true value, as this ensures I win whenever my value exceeds the price I'd pay, and I never overpay. Bidding higher than my value risks winning at a loss; bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. With my value at $10, I should bid exactly $10 to maximize expected profit.
